sentences.en: Education is one of the most essential aspects of life.
sentences.zh: 教育是生活中最重要的方面之一。

sentences.en: The committee held a discussion on the problem of education.
sentences.zh: 委员会就教育问题进行了讨论。

sentences.en: With more education, he would have found a better job.
sentences.zh: 有了更好的教育，他就能找到一份更好的工作。
